name: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
instructions: Cook the spaghetti. Fry the guanciale. Mix eggs, pecorino romano, and black pepper. Combine everything.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix in flour and chocolate chips. Bake.

name: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocados. Dice onion, tomato, and cilantro. Mix everything with lime juice and salt.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Stir-fry chicken. Add vegetables, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Cook until tender.

name: Margarita Pizza
instructions: Roll out pizza dough. Spread tomato sauce. Add mozzarella cheese and basil leaves. Bake.

name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash and chop lettuce. Add croutons, parmesan cheese, and Caesar dressing. Toss and serve.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and vegetable broth. Simmer. Blend and garnish with basil.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, milk, and eggs. Cook on a griddle with butter.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook ground beef. Warm tortillas. Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and salsa.

name: Fruit Salad
instructions: Wash and chop fruits. Mix together and garnish with mint.
